h1: A WordPress website that actually grows your business.

jsonLd.name: WordPress Website Development
jsonLd.description: Custom WordPress and WooCommerce website development for Indian businesses — design, build, migration, SEO setup and ongoing support.

mainEntity.name: Do you build custom WordPress sites, or just install a template?

acceptedAnswer.text: We design and build around your brand — custom theming where it matters, and efficient use of tools like Elementor or WooCommerce where that's genuinely the right call. Not a one-size-fits-all template.

mainEntity.name: Can you migrate my existing website to WordPress?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — migrating from another platform, or fixing a slow or poorly-built WordPress site (content, SEO redirects, speed), is one of our core services.

mainEntity.name: Do you build online stores with WooCommerce?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, including Indian payment gateway integration such as Razorpay, PayU or Cashfree.

mainEntity.name: How much does a WordPress website cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends on scope. You get a fixed-price proposal after a free call, so you know the number before committing — no vague hourly guesswork.

mainEntity.name: Do you offer ongoing maintenance after launch?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — updates, backups, security and support plans are available. We'll go through options on the call.

mainEntity.name: Is this different from your React Native / app development work?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes — this is a dedicated website service from the same senior team, for businesses that need a website rather than a mobile app. We can build both if you need them.

blocks.html:
A WordPress website
that actually grows your business.

Custom-built, fast-loading WordPress & WooCommerce websites for Indian businesses — designed and engineered by the same senior team behind our React Native and AI products. No template shortcuts, built for SEO from day one.
Custom-built, not just a theme install

Everything your business
website needs to do.
Custom WordPress sites that load fast and actually reflect the brand — not a generic template with your logo swapped in.
Full e-commerce builds — products, inventory, shipping and Indian payment gateways like Razorpay, PayU or Cashfree.
Moving from an old host, builder or a slow WordPress site — with content, SEO redirects and performance handled properly.
When a page builder can't do what you need, we write the PHP and JavaScript ourselves — no hacky workarounds.
Technical SEO set up from launch — schema markup, sitemaps, Core Web Vitals and mobile performance, not an afterthought.
Chat assistants, smart search or content tools — built with the same Claude/GPT integration work we do for our app clients.

blocks.text: Why founders in India pick us

blocks.html: Built by the same senior engineers who ship production React Native, MERN and AI apps — not a template shop churning out lookalike sites.
Based in India, working India business hours — no timezone friction, no midnight calls to get an update.
A clear proposal before a line of code is written. You know the number before you commit a rupee.
You work directly with the engineer building your site — not an account manager relaying messages back and forth.

Brief to live site,
without the back-and-forth.
Goals, content and the metric that matters — leads, sales or bookings. Fixed-price proposal within 48 hours.
A clean layout built around your brand, mobile-first from the first mockup.
WordPress (and WooCommerce, where needed) built cleanly, with weekly progress you can see.
Go live with SEO basics in place, then ongoing maintenance and support available.

Tell us about your website.
We'll reply within one business day.
Fill in the form and it goes straight to our team — no forms disappearing into a queue. Prefer to talk first? Book a free call instead, or message us on WhatsApp.
No obligation. We'll come back with a fixed-price proposal.
